headline: Audit cleanup — small fixes from a sweep across the last several releases.

items.prompt_template: A small cleanup pass — no new features. Tied up about 17 paper-cuts and consistency items that surfaced after the recent release arc: automation scaffolding now actually uses its helper, monthly intro check-ins surface in your daily pulse, stale references to retired skills swept across documentation, decision-revisit routing fixed, Friday Wrap counts reconciled, board-pack QuickBooks failure modes documented, and a new automated guard to block this drift class going forward. Two new note types added to my recognized list. No action needed.
